audience: people and teams who track time in TimeCamp and want to review or correct their entries

useCases.title: Review last week's tracked time by task
useCases.text: List the time entries between two dates, optionally for given tasks. List the tasks to match the task ids with their names.

useCases.title: Check whether a timer is running
useCases.text: Read the connected user, then check whether a timer runs and on which task and since when.

useCases.title: Add a time entry for a finished call
useCases.text: Create a time entry for one day, with a start and end time or a duration in seconds, and a note. Each call adds a new entry.

useCases.title: Start or stop a timer
useCases.text: Start a timer on a task, or stop the running timer and save its time as an entry.

useCases.title: Correct or delete a time entry
useCases.text: Change the date, times, duration, task or note of one time entry. Delete an entry that should not exist.
